root_cause: The container image "nginx:does-not-exist" could not be found in the registry.
The pod cannot pull the image because the registry host "registry.invalid" cannot be resolved, causing a DNS lookup failure.
The pod’s image name "nginx::bad" is not a valid Docker image reference, causing the image pull to fail.
The container exits because the required environment variable DB_URL is missing.
The application container exits immediately because it cannot connect to the Postgres database at host "db" on port 5432, resulting in a connection refused error.
The container was killed because it requested 200 MiB of memory with the stress command, but the pod’s memory limit was set to only 50 MiB.
The container fails to start because the specified command "/bin/doesnotexist" does not exist in the image, causing an exec error during container init.
The pod cannot start because the ConfigMap "app-config" referenced in its spec does not exist.
The pod cannot start because the referenced secret "db-credentials" does not exist in the namespace.
